⚠️🚘 TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Please be advised that street line painting, including crosswalks and centre lines, will begin on Tuesday, May 19 and continue throughout the summer, with the schedule being weather-dependent.

Motorists are advised to consider alternate routes to avoid possible delays, as well as to be considerate of, and always obey, construction personnel and signage as these projects progress.

#Summerside

MPV, bumangga sa plastic barrier at traffic signage sa northbound lane ng EDSA pagbaba ng Quezon Ave. flyover sa Quezon City bago mag 1 AM ngayong May 13, 2026.

Ayon sa TNVS driver, sumama ang kaniyang pakiramdam at hindi niya napansin na bumangga na sa barrier. 

Nagtamo ng sugat sa mukha ang babaeng pasahero na galing Makati at pauwi na sa Project 8. 

Patuloy ang imbestigasyon ng MMDA at QCPD Traffic Sector 6. | via James Agustin/GMA News

Bisitahin ang https://t.co/bAMF9JO2Xs para sa updates.
